title: Brain Health Protocols: 14 modifiable dementia risk factors and what to do about each
summary: A Blueprint blog essay by Vanessa Gibbs listing 14 modifiable dementia risk factors (up to 45% of cases preventable or delayable) with protocols for each, covering exercise, alcohol, air quality, hearing, blood pressure and cholesterol. Bryan Johnson is only mentioned in the third person, so he is not the speaker.
